title: cryptocarya oblonga
intro: Cryptocarya oblonga, commonly known as Ceylon ironwood, is a plant species native to Sri Lanka. It is a tree with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cryptocarya oblonga include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects.
